status_definitions.unknown: No sufficient applicable primary text obtained; neither permission nor legal prohibition established.
status_definitions.express_terms_restriction: Reviewed terms expressly restrict this activity; contractual enforceability and statutory exceptions are outside this audit.
status_definitions.scope_unclear: A limited licence exists, but this precise derived/private/cloud use is not established.
status_definitions.conditional_personal_copy: Permission wording supports the described personal copy, subject to notices and other terms.
status_definitions.restriction_likely_applies_scope_unconfi: Applying broad anti-scraping wording to an AI browser is an inference; user direction alone is not an exemption.
status_definitions.permission_not_established: The proposed operation is not supported by a verified grant; this is not a conclusion of illegality.

interpretation: Robot rules are protocol declarations, not contract/IP licences.
Personal download permission does not automatically cover automated discovery, cloud-model transmission, persistent raw HTML, multiple normalized copies, or republication.
Private factual analysis and reprinting copyright excerpts/images are separate operations; this audit does not ban analysis of lawfully obtained facts.
No public inventory read API was located in the bounded official-domain searches. Owner upload/CRM/supplier portals are not a substitute.
Suggested file-based no-paste routes still require the user to select/save or share a document unless automated access is separately supported; they are not zero-touch integrations.
searches: Official-domain terms and brochure/download searches for all providers; unrelated auction, service-brochure and country variants not treated as rental access grants.
